Ranks Montgomery census tracts by CDC adult asthma prevalence per adult and left-joins 2026 code-violation counts, preserving null health values and keeping geoid last for mapping.
sql:
SELECT
  t.name AS tract_name,
  CAST(c.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate,
  CAST(c.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS adult_population,
  COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS code_violations_2026,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN session.fw_163300_m1_cdc AS c
  ON c.tractfips = t.geoid
LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts AS v
  ON v.geoid = t.geoid
  AND v.run_id = 'r_20261024_163300'
  AND v.source = 'm2_city'
  AND v.grp = 'all'
ORDER BY adult_asthma_rate DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
